summary: FR3 preview contract gap found and fixed. ActivityRenderer previously did not accept or forward activity configuration props, so authored content (equation, questions, template, etc.) never reached rendered activity components — the preview showed hardcoded shell content. Fixed by: (1) adding activityProps to ActivityRenderer interface and forwarding via spread, (2) updating AuthoredLessonPreview to pass authored props through, (3) updating GraphingExplorerActivity and ComprehensionQuizActivity to accept optional config props with backward-compatible defaults, (4) strengthening the vacuous A4 test assertion to actually verify authored props reach the rendered component. FR3/AC2 is now satisfied: authored content renders through the same ActivityRenderer path a student uses, with configuration props forwarded. Composer/status DTO is coherent with Phase 2 teacherFacingStatus/rejectionComment. tracks.md marks track as PLANNED (conservative, no A6 overstatement).

evidence: FR3/AC2 priority finding: Before fix, ActivityRendererProps had no activityProps field; React.createElement passed only {activityId, mode, onSubmit, onComplete} — authored config was dropped. AuthoredLessonPreview rendered ActivityRenderer without activityProps. Test at line 150 only asserted activityId was defined (A4 vacuous).

Fix: Added activityProps?: Record<string, unknown> to ActivityRendererProps; spread into createElement call. AuthoredLessonPreview passes activity.props as activityProps. Test strengthened to assert lastCall.equation === 'x^2 + 3x - 4'.
GraphingExplorerActivity: Added optional equation/variant props with backward-compatible defaults ('y = x^2', 'plot_from_equation'). Previously hardcoded.
ComprehensionQuizActivity: Added optional questions prop; uses resolvedQuestions = questions ?? sampleQuestions. Previously hardcoded sampleQuestions.
FillInTheBlankActivity, RateOfChangeCalculatorActivity, DiscriminantAnalyzerActivity, StepByStepSolverActivity: Already accept config props — no changes needed.
Targeted gate: 8 files / 121 tests pass. TypeScript: exit 0. Lint: exit 0.
Pre-existing ActivityRenderer-graphing-explorer.test.tsx failure confirmed not caused by this change (fails at baseline too).

Composer/status DTO: getTeacherAuthoringStatusView correctly maps teacherFacingStatus (draft/submitted/approved/rejected/published) + rejectionComment, throws on unknown statuses. Consistent with Phase 2 DTOs.
Composer UI (LessonComposer): schema-driven forms, SanitizedText, keyboard-operable controls, accessible labels — all per DESIGN.md and spec NFR.
